subject: [RFC PATCH 19/57] mm/collapse: install a PMD leaf as the terminal layer

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch installs a PMD leaf as the terminal layer in the mm/collapse code. It does this by first verifying that the pmd is valid, then detaching the old table and depositing a fresh one under the protection of the pmd lock. The patch ensures that no pmd_none() window exists during this process, preventing faults from escaping to the pte level. This approach allows PMD collapse to run under mmap_read like other operations in the code. The patch also handles aborts and ensures that the deposited table is quiescent, while the detached table is freed after all walkers have finished.
